title: Sorted keys after a stable pass
statement: Let $\pi,\pi'$ be lists of natural numbers, let $k,d$ be functions from natural numbers to natural numbers, and let $B$ be a natural number. Suppose $\pi'$ has the same length as $\pi$ and places each entry of $\pi$ at the position given by the number of entries with smaller $k$-key plus the number of earlier entries with equal $k$-key. Assume also that $g(i)<B$ for every entry $i$ of $\pi$, and that the values of $g$ along $\pi$ are nondecreasing. Then the values $k(i)B+g(i)$ along $\pi'$ are nondecreasing.
hypotheses_covered: Equal lengths and the stated stable rank placement condition
The values of $g$ along $\pi$ are pairwise nondecreasing
